gene_rules.summary: Hereditary predisposition to clear-cell RCC (von Hippel-Lindau). New, multifocal or contralateral tumours are possible.

case_implications.text: Hereditary risk of new tumours: kidney-sparing options and lifelong surveillance matter.
Family counselling to be considered by a geneticist.

gene_rules.summary: Pathogenic variant in a hereditary renal cancer predisposition gene.

case_implications.text: Hereditary RCC syndrome to be confirmed by a geneticist; it can change surveillance and surgical planning.

gene_rules.summary: High-risk APOL1 genotype (two risk alleles): increased risk of CKD progression.

case_implications.text: Two APOL1 risk alleles: relevant to kidney-function follow-up (Renal Guardian).

gene_rules.summary: Single APOL1 risk allele (carrier). The high-risk genotype needs two risk alleles; on its own this is not expected to drive CKD progression.

pathogenic.summary: Pathogenic per the laboratory. No gene-specific rule in the Knowledge Model: geneticist review required.

likely_pathogenic.summary: Likely pathogenic per the laboratory. No gene-specific rule in the Knowledge Model: geneticist review required.

risk_allele.summary: Risk allele per the laboratory. No gene-specific rule in the Knowledge Model: geneticist review required.

vus.summary: Variant of uncertain significance: not clinically actionable; do not use for decisions.
